description: The same three per-SDK 'Encrypting Your Data' links (Go, Java, Python) appear word-for-word as a NOTE block on both sibling pages rather than being stated once and cross-referenced. Also worth noting on its own: field-level encryption is documented only as three per-SDK-language pages, each independently versioned, with no server-side page - consistent with it being an SDK-side capability, but it means there is no single place to learn whether it exists.
